Name: Porg Replacer for Chickens
Author: plasticpalfun
Description:
This is a simple sprite replacer for the White Chicken, Brown, Chicken, and Blue Chicken assets, targeting Pathoschild's ContentPatcher.

There is a little basic configurability: players can choose which of the porg assets to replace the chickens with by editing [code]config.json[/code]. For the moment, this is only available for the White Chicken and Brown Chicken sprites. The default configuration is:
﻿
[code]{
 "WhiteChickenSkin": "porg",
 "BrownChickenSkin": "porgcheek"
}[/code]

Presently, the Blue Chickens are replaced by purple porgs; eventually, porgs matching the standard palette may be made available. A Void Chicken sprite replacement is planned as well.

Downloads.Description: Requires SMAPIv 2.7+ and Content Patcher v1.4+.
